skill.name: ecommerce-customer-service
skill.description: 当用户需要回答商品咨询、整理售前FAQ或起草售后解释时使用。输入商品链接或资料、买家问题与已确认的店铺规则，输出可复制回复和商家待核实事项。在线商品详情支持抖音与小红书，已有资料可直接起草；不自动发送消息或办理售后。来自 SocialDataX 社媒数据助手。
skill.summary: Draft buyer replies and product FAQs from verified facts and store policies, with optional Douyin and Xiaohongshu product lookups.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: The CLI workflow runs an unpinned npm package and gives it access to a service key from the environment or a local credential file. Product lookup examples lack safe argument handling guidance, and billing instructions rely on links supplied by errors without specifying validation. Most static alerts are Markdown or documentation references, and no evidence of audit-directed prompt injection or credential theft was found.

remediation.issue: Unpinned npm execution with credential access
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed, pinned CLI release and verify its integrity before execution. Require user approval for installation and execution, and expose only the credentials needed for the lookup.
Prefer a managed secret store and make local persistence opt-in. Verify access controls on each supported platform and document credential removal and rotation.

remediation.issue: Product identifiers embedded in shell examples
remediation.suggestion: Pass user input as separate arguments without a shell. Validate product and SKU identifier formats and restrict URLs to approved product domains.

remediation.issue: Billing links copied from service errors
remediation.suggestion: Always use the fixed vendor billing URL instead of copying a link from an error. Ask the user to verify the account before adding credits.

content.value_statement: Buyer questions often arrive before product details or store policies are confirmed. Draft a reply from available facts and list what the merchant still needs to verify.
actual_capabilities: Draft buyer replies from supplied product facts and confirmed store policies.
Look up Douyin product details by product ID or URL through SocialDataX when configured.
Look up Xiaohongshu product details by SKU ID or URL through SocialDataX when configured.
Separate the buyer-facing reply from facts that the merchant needs to verify.
Organize product FAQs by question, answer, fact source, applicable conditions, and items to update.
limitations: This skill drafts messages but does not send them, issue refunds, approve compensation, or change orders or listings.
Online lookup is limited to Douyin and Xiaohongshu product details and requires authenticated SocialDataX access.
Product details do not verify inventory, order status, or delivery dates.
Refund timing, return eligibility, and compensation depend on confirmed policies and authorized decisions.

use_cases.title: Answer a Product Question
use_cases.description: Turn a buyer question and a product specification sheet into a short reply. Keep any unverified details in a separate internal note.

use_cases.title: Build a Product FAQ
use_cases.description: Group recurring buyer questions and write answers tied to the right product variants, sources, and conditions.

use_cases.title: Explain an After-Sales Decision
use_cases.description: Draft a buyer update using an approved resolution. Flag missing order facts for an authorized colleague.

prompt_templates.title: Draft One Reply
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: A buyer asks about a known product feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use only these product facts: [facts]. Draft a short reply to this buyer question: [question].

prompt_templates.title: Separate Facts From Open Questions
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Product information is incomplete or differs by variant.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a buyer reply to [question] using [product facts] and [confirmed store policy]. List missing details and conflicting sources under a separate merchant heading.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Product FAQ
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: A team is documenting repeated pre-sale questions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn [buyer questions] into an FAQ using [product sources]. For each answer, record the source, applicable variant or conditions, and anything that needs verification.

prompt_templates.title: Explain an Approved Resolution
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: A buyer asks for an update on an after-sales case.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a reply to [buyer question] using [confirmed case facts], [store policy], and [approved resolution]. Separate internal follow-ups and do not imply any pending action is complete.

output_examples.input: A buyer asks how long a 500 mL screw-top cup keeps drinks warm and whether it can arrive tomorrow. Neither detail is confirmed.
output: Buyer reply: This is the 500 mL screw-top cup. We do not have a verified heat-retention time or delivery estimate yet.
Merchant check: Confirm tested heat retention and check the delivery estimate for the order.

output_examples.input: Build a sizing FAQ from a verified chart that lists the navy medium jacket as 104 cm around the chest. No other variants are documented.
output: Question: What is the chest measurement of the navy medium jacket?
Suggested answer: The navy jacket in size medium measures 104 cm around the chest.
Source: Verified size chart. This measurement applies only to navy medium.
Merchant check: Verify the measurements for other sizes and colors.

best_practices: Provide the exact buyer question, the product variant, and any confirmed store policies.
Keep internal checks separate from the buyer reply and review the draft before sending.
Use only verified product facts and remove personal details that are not needed for the reply.
anti_patterns: Promise delivery, refund timing, or compensation based only on a product listing.
Treat an unverified suggestion or pending action as a completed resolution.
Paste API keys, full addresses, or unrelated order details into prompts.

faq.question: Can I draft a reply without an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the buyer question and enough verified product information to draft the reply without an online lookup.

faq.question: Which product links can the skill look up?
faq.answer: It supports Douyin and Xiaohongshu product links through SocialDataX. For other platforms, provide the relevant product details directly.

faq.question: What does online lookup require?
faq.answer: It requires an authenticated SocialDataX connection. The documented CLI route uses Node.js, npm, and a SocialDataX API key.

faq.question: Can it send replies or process refunds?
faq.answer: No. It drafts replies for review and does not contact buyers, issue refunds, or modify orders.

faq.question: Can it confirm inventory or delivery dates?
faq.answer: No. Product details do not verify inventory or shipping status. Provide confirmed information or leave those details for the merchant to check.

faq.question: What happens when product sources disagree?
faq.answer: The draft identifies the conflict and keeps relevant variant and price conditions explicit. An uncertain claim stays out of the buyer reply.
